category_title: Students who avoid participation due to anxiety and low confidence
scenario_title: Persevering with academic work and presenting to class
minimal_context: The student is working on an academic task in a mainstream classroom and is expected to present their work at the front of the class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please finish the rest of the worksheet. When you are finished, I need you to come up to the front of the class to show your example.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know how to do this new part. I'm just going to stop.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep trying. The first question you finished was well done.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No it wasn't well done. It's probably all wrong.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It's time to share now. Please bring your paper to the front of the class so everyone can see.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shrinks down in his seat) I'm not going up there. I'm not showing my example to the class, everyone is going to look at me and know I did it wrong.

TUTOR: Please finish the rest of the worksheet. When you are finished, I need you to come up to the front of the class to show your example.

task.content: Participating in academic tasks, seeking help, and presenting work in front of the mainstream class

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When faced with demanding situations or expectations to show examples to the class
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Giving up quickly, not willing to seek assistance if needed, and not speaking out in class
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Anxiety about losing face in front of classmates if expectations were not met

behavior_patterns.condition: When receiving verbal praise or compliments for something well done
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Requires believing oneself to be both competent and worthy of recognition
related_quotes: In September, she couldn't even handle 'well done'
